<<<POU name=AutoDoor kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK AutoDoor
VAR_INPUT
    presence : BOOL;
    openLimit : BOOL;
    closeLimit : BOOL;
    obstacle : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    openCmd : BOOL;
    closeCmd : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    stage : INT := 0;
    hold : TON;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
openCmd := FALSE;
closeCmd := FALSE;
CASE stage OF
0:
    IF presence THEN
        stage := 1;
    END_IF
1:
    openCmd := TRUE;
    IF openLimit THEN
        stage := 2;
    END_IF
2:
    IF presence OR obstacle THEN
        stage := 1;
    ELSE
        hold(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3s);
        IF hold.Q THEN
            stage := 3;
        END_IF
    END_IF
3:
    closeCmd := TRUE;
    IF presence OR obstacle THEN
        stage := 1;
        hold(IN := FALSE, PT := T#3s);
    ELSIF closeLimit THEN
        stage := 0;
    END_IF
END_CASE
(* intentional behavior bug for mock *)
openCmd := FALSE;
closeCmd := FALSE;
<<<END>>>
